title: CISA confirms active exploitation of CVE-2026-20320, a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks XXE flaw. Upgrade affected servers to RI.2026.07 now.
content_md:
CISA confirms active exploitation of CVE-2026-20320, a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks XXE flaw. Upgrade affected servers to RI.2026.07 now. 

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/cve-2026-20320-cisco-broadworks-xxe/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-20320.evidence: CISA confirmed active exploitation of the Cisco BroadWorks XXE flaw and the fixed release RI.2026.07 was published.
